document.name: Williamsburg Soccer Club North Williamsburg
document.shortDescription: Weekly spring soccer classes in North Williamsburg for ages 2-5 at JCC Brooklyn.
document.longDescription:
JCC Brooklyn's official North Williamsburg page lists Williamsburg Soccer Club classes for young children at 14 Hope Street in Williamsburg. The official program page describes a weekly kids soccer class for boys and girls, with a Spring Session of nine classes on April 15, 22, 29, May 6, 13, 20, 27, and June 3 and 10.

The same official page lists a 3:00 PM class for ages 2-3 and a 3:45 PM class for ages 4-5, which supports weekday afternoon and after-school timing tags. Williamsburg Soccer Club's official site describes the program as kids soccer classes in Williamsburg for players ages 2-8, but this listing stays aligned to the North Williamsburg class block published on the JCC page.

Sources: https://www.jcc-brooklyn.org/north-williamsburg/programs/0-5/williamsburg-soccer-club/ https://www.williamsburgsoccerclub.com/ https://static.wixstatic.com/media/6b81be_c3d3378043ae4e20a9bb3b615b18baef%7Emv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/6b81be_c3d3378043ae4e20a9bb3b615b18baef%7Emv2.png
